name: liber-usualis
description: A project dedicated to making the Mass, Hours, and Rites of various editions of the Roman Rite easily accessible and beautifully formatted with or without their chants.

scripts.build: esbuild frontend/pray/js/pray.js --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outdir=web/resources/dist --format=iife && esbuild frontend/pray/css/pray.css --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=web/resources/dist/pray.css && esbuild frontend/shared/css/style.css --bundle --minify --sourcemap --external:/resources/* --outfile=web/resources/dist/style.css
scripts.watch: esbuild frontend/pray/js/pray.js --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outdir=web/resources/dist --format=iife && esbuild frontend/pray/css/pray.css --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=web/resources/dist/pray.css && esbuild frontend/shared/css/style.css --bundle --minify --sourcemap --external:/resources/* --outfile=web/resources/dist/style.css
